# KingdomTradex - Complete Platform Documentation

## Overview

KingdomTradex is a faith-grounded cryptocurrency earnings platform that uses an AI-powered trading engine to generate projected daily returns for depositors. Users deposit cryptocurrency, select a lock tier, and earn daily returns without manual trading.

## Tier System

| Tier | Daily Rate | Duration | Min Deposit | Total Return |
|------|-----------|----------|-------------|-------------|
| Silver | 1.0% | 180 days | $50 | 180% |
| Gold | 1.2% | 270 days | $100 | 324% |
| Platinum | 1.4% | 360 days | $500 | 504% |
| Diamond | 1.6% | 540 days | $1000 | 864% |

## KYC Levels

- Level 0: Unverified (signup only, no withdrawals)
- Level 1: Email Verified (up to $100/week profit withdrawal)
- Level 2: Authenticator Enabled (up to $1000/week profit withdrawal)
- Level 3: ID Verified (up to $10000/week profit withdrawal)
- Level 4: Fully Verified (unlimited profit withdrawal)

## Referral Program

5-level MLM commission structure:

Deposit Bonus: L1 3%, L2 1.5%, L3 0.75%, L4 0.5%, L5 0.25%
Profit Share: L1 5%, L2 2.5%, L3 1.25%, L4 0.75%, L5 0.5%

## Principal Withdrawal

Early withdrawal (before lock maturity): 25% forfeit + 48-hour cooling period
Matured withdrawal (after lock completes): No penalty, instant

## Deposit Split

60% auto-converts to XMR and sends to cold storage wallet
40% retained in USDT for withdrawal payouts, referral commissions, and operations

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: Next.js 14.2, React 18, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Charts: Recharts (AreaChart, BarChart)
- Animations: GSAP (ScrollTrigger, power2 easing)
- Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL with Row Level Security)
- Authentication: Session-based with CSRF protection
- Payments: NOWPayments API (invoices, payouts, IPN webhooks)
- AI Support: DeepSeek V4 Flash (chat agent)

## API Structure

Public: /api/auth/*, /api/waitlist/*
Authenticated: /api/user/*, /api/deposit/*, /api/withdraw/*, /api/withdrawals/*
Admin: /api/admin/kyc, /api/admin/settings, /api/admin/withdrawals/*
Cron: /api/cron/daily-profit, /api/cron/mature-locks, /api/cron/process-withdrawals
Webhooks: /api/webhooks/nowpayments, /api/webhooks/nowpayments-ipn

## Database Tables

Core: users, deposits, withdrawals, sessions, deposit_locks, lock_tiers
Referrals: referral_commissions
KYC: kyc_submissions
Notifications: notifications
Trading: ai_trading_profits
Admin: settings, admin_logs
Support: support_tickets, ticket_attachments
Social: social_shares, share_verifications, testimonies

## Compliance

All returns are projected and estimated. Cryptocurrency investments carry risk. This platform is not a registered securities exchange or investment advisor.
